title: Ex-GM CEO on Mary Barra succession planning: 'It's going to be tough'
summary_full: Former GM CEO Dan Akerson says whoever replaces Mary Barra will have a difficult task because they'll inherit rapid change in technology and the auto industry.
summary_public: Former GM CEO Dan Akerson says whoever replaces Mary Barra will have a difficult task because they'll inherit rapid change in technology and the auto industry.
